name: Slovenia
prevalence_note: Slovenian police and SI-CERT warnings 2025-2026: fake crypto exchanges with 'forgotten bitcoins', fake Microsoft support, fake Pošta Slovenije parcel fees and fake bank security asking for passwords.

scams.name: Lažna kripto borza: pozabljeni bitcoini
scams.name_en: Fake crypto exchange with forgotten bitcoins
scams.signals_en: A caller from a crypto exchange says the owner has forgotten bitcoins to pay out and asks for remote access, online banking access, an ID scan or card details.
scams.legit_en: Real exchanges never call about forgotten coins and never ask for online banking access or remote control.
bait_tactics: Reči, da mora poiskati očala, in vprašati, koliko naj bi bilo tega denarja
Vprašati, kdaj naj bi bil račun odprt

scams.name: Lažna Microsoftova tehnična pomoč
scams.signals_en: A caller from Microsoft support says the computer is infected or the licence has expired and asks to install TeamViewer or similar and give card details.
scams.legit_en: Microsoft never calls users about viruses or licences.
bait_tactics: Reči, da se računalnik zelo počasi prižiga, in vprašati, kaj naj bi videl na zaslonu

scams.name: Lažna Pošta Slovenije: doplačilo poštnine
scams.signals_en: A caller or text from the post says a parcel waits for a small extra postage and asks for card details and the CVV through a payment link.
scams.legit_en: Pošta Slovenije never asks for card details or CVV codes by phone or through links in texts.
bait_tactics: Reči, da išče očala, in vprašati, od kod je paket

scams.name: Lažna varnostna služba banke: geslo in enkratna koda
scams.name_en: Fake bank security asking for password and code
scams.signals_en: A caller from the bank's security service reports a suspicious payment or a blocked account and asks for the online banking password, the SMS code or to confirm a transaction.
scams.legit_en: Banks never ask for online banking passwords or SMS codes by phone.
bait_tactics: Reči, da se aplikacija banke posodablja, in prositi, naj še enkrat razloži
